IVIg rapidly and selectively decreases circulating pathogenic antibodies in pemphigous vulgaris.

IVIg is a safe, effective, and rapid treatment for severe and life-threatening pemphigus, and that the mechanism of action is a rapid and selective decrease in circulating pathogenic auto-antibodies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IVIg is a safe and effective treatment for the rapid control of active and severe PV and that it is a valuable adjunct to conventional therapy.
IVIG is an excellent treatment for PV.

IVIg can control PV rapidly by decreasing the circulating levels of the pathogenic autoantobodies that mediate it, and that it does so by selectively increasing the catabolic rate of these antibodies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IVIg can be used to treat severe cases of pemphigus and that it is very likely to be effective in all other autoimmune blistering diseases.
IVIg is a highly selective treatment for PV and probably other autoimmune bullous diseases.
